changelog: Aura AI v2.0.4 ChatGPT-Style White Sidebar & Customize Screen
ChatGPT-Style White Theme Sidebar: Clean white surface with flat right edge, 44dp circular search button, and crisp dark status bar icons
Fixed Navigation Menu: Top rows for Images, Customize, Projects, Tasks, and Plugins with rounded ripple feedback
Streamlined Chat History: Single-line chat titles, selection pills, 32dp soft alpha fade, and long-press context menu
Redesigned Footer: 44dp settings gear, 44dp circular teal initials avatar badge, and avatar popup menu with Account, Archived Chats, Workspace Grouping, and Exit App
New Full-Screen Customize Screen: 3 grouped cards with colorful multi-tone icons for Personality, Memory, Plugins, Email, Calendar, Contacts, Passwords, and Location with sub-screen routing
